headline: Avianca Adds 28 Flights to Clear Passenger Backlog at Bogota and Medellin
summary: Avianca activated 6,682 extra seats and 28 additional flights to accommodate travelers impacted by bad weather at Colombia's main hubs.
why: Avianca is Colombia's flag carrier and the largest airline operator in the Andean region.

impacts.name: Avianca
impacts.why: Avianca deployed additional aircraft capacity to manage flight delays.
